context: A Kansai chef and a barista swap event-prep ideas
purpose: Teach: ピアニスト/レコーダー/音源/綿/おばあさん/民家/プロセッサ/早稲田

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: アオイさん、ライブ予定あるんやて?
lines.en: So Aoi-san, I hear you've got a live coming up?
lines.style: Warm, loud opening with Kansai rhythm. Leaning forward with genuine interest. Easy grin underneath the words. No pressure—just happy to have heard.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、ピアニストの友達と組んで、店で開きます。
lines.en: Yeah, with a pianist friend. We're doing it at the shop.
lines.style: Modest but steady. Clear enough to be heard, but not performing. A small smile in the voice—she's proud but won't say it outright. Grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 録音もすんの?ええプロセッサのPC持ってる?
lines.en: You're recording it too? You've got a decent PC for that?
lines.style: Practical turn. Leans in with real curiosity—not skeptical, actually wanting to help think it through. Quick pace, interested, problem-solving tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。古いレコーダーも併用して、二系統で残します。
lines.en: Yeah. I'm using an old recorder as backup—so I'll have two separate captures to work with.
lines.style: Confident without bragging. Matter-of-fact delivery. She's thought this through. Slight lift at 'two-channel'—small satisfaction of a real plan.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うちのおばあさんの民家、綿の毛布貸せるで。音源の保管にも使えるで。
lines.en: Oh, and my grandma's place—I can lend you some cotton blankets. Good for storing the files too, keeps them dry.
lines.style: Generous and loud, the way Daichi gives. Not performative—just obvious to him. Quick, almost offhand delivery because it's so natural to help. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 早稲田の友達も来てくれるって。楽しみです。
lines.en: Friends from Waseda are coming too. I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Soft lift toward the end. Warm, grounded gratitude. The voice of someone whose nervousness has become excitement. Quiet certainty.
